<Subject 1> is the performer (S1) in <Picture 1> (P1), the four-panel character sheet of the same man (face close-up, front, three-quarter, back): a Chinese man in his early thirties, lean face with high cheekbones, thick brows and short stubble, long dark-brown dreadlocks partly tied at the back with loose strands falling over the forehead, a thick grey knitted scarf wound twice around his neck, and worn bronze-studded leather armour with layered pauldrons over a dark under-layer. <Picture 4> (SC6) is the rendered supplementary plate for "粗陶酒碗与封泥酒坛 · 道具静物": a still life of a rough unglazed clay wine bowl and a sealed clay jar with a half-untied cloth seal on dark timber, warm lantern light and shallow depth of field; keep its architecture, palette and light.

detailed_description:
Cinematic 16:9 film still from an ancient frontier-jianghu music video: warm lantern amber against cold snow-blue, heavy weathered texture, shallow depth of field, natural motivated light.
[Shot 1] Close-up, frontal three-quarter, framed from the eyes to the collarbone. <Picture 1> (P1), matching the build and costume of <Picture 2> (P2), sits at the rough timber table of the lantern-lit tavern (<Picture 3>, plate SC3). He drinks the rough clay bowl of clear liquor dry in one motion (<Picture 4>, plate SC6); the burn hits, his eyes water and his lids tighten, he wipes his mouth with the back of his hand, lifts his gaze into the lens and sings, mouth fully readable in close-up. Faint ember light sits low in his wet eyes (<Picture 5>, plate SC9). Camera: a crash zoom that snaps from CU to ECU and settles back to CU, large amplitude, fast speed. When <Audio 1> reaches the phrase <d>[中文] 一杯二锅头。</d>, <Subject 1> keeps his lips word-for-word in sync with the audible line; when <Audio 1> reaches the phrase <d>[中文] 呛得眼泪流。</d>, the same word-for-word sync holds through the wet blink; when <Audio 1> reaches the phrase <d>[中文] 生旦净末丑。</d>, his jaw and mouth shapes match each syllable as heard; when <Audio 1> reaches the phrase <d>[中文] 好汉不回头。</d>, the sync holds and one corner of his mouth pulls up. Terminal frame: the empty bowl set down with a dull knock.
Negative constraints: no overexposed highlights, no pure black crushed shadows, no sharp aliasing, no cheap plastic reflections, no blurry smooth textures.
overall_soundscape:
Copy of the ambience layer from <Audio 1>, plus the diegetic detail of this location: liquor swallowed hard, one sharp breath pulled back, the dull knock of a clay bowl on timber and the room's low lantern hum.
non_diegetic_music:
<Audio 1> is directly reused as the complete audience-only score and vocal; no additional score is generated.
